hooks.name: doc-file-warning
hooks.description: Warn when documentation files are created without explicit user request

action.prompt:
A documentation file was just created. If this was not explicitly requested by the user, consider whether it's truly necessary. Documentation should be created only when:

1. Explicitly requested by the user
2. Required for project setup or usage
3. Part of a formal specification or requirement

If you created documentation that wasn't requested, briefly explain why it's necessary or remove it.
